items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: I heard Count Basie did too.

ctx.x: Oh, Tommy Dorsey had a baseball team. Most of them had a baseball team.
I heard Count Basie did too.
Yes, yes, yes. We played up in Central Park. It was — yeah Harry, “Oh watch that equipment,” you know the bats and the gloves and the balls and everything.
